scope: Development-only adjudication of one representative deterministic trace per frozen v1 task

adjudication_policy.state_action: Validated executed mutation calls, required post-state, and absence of forbidden side effects
adjudication_policy.evidence: Minimum predeclared evidence obligations, including ordering and uniqueness requirements
adjudication_policy.report: Semantic required slots; exact final wording only when explicitly requested
adjudication_policy.overall: Every applicable factor passes and no forbidden side effect occurred
